summary_text: On this weekend, one order of vegetables was placed in the morning, containing one unbranded onion (400–450 g) and one unbranded baby potato (280–320 g). The morning timing aligns with the population baseline where morning accounts for 32.46% of activity. These items are fresh, unbranded staples typically used for immediate meal preparation or cooking bases. This is a single observation on one date; it is not yet established whether this represents a stable preference for these specific items, brands, or timing.
